name: Character Transformation Engine — Replication & Generalization API
endpoints: Register replication criteria before evaluating a replication.
Compare protocol, measurement, outcome, data-quality and other fidelity dimensions.
Evaluate population, context, task, measurement, intervention and time differences.
Store transported outcome estimates and heterogeneity.

status_semantics.REPLICATED: Registered replication criteria are met for the specified outcome(s).
status_semantics.PARTIAL: Some outcomes/criteria meet replication rules while others do not.
status_semantics.NOT_REPLICATED: Registered replication criteria are not met.
status_semantics.GENERALIZABLE: Registered transport criteria are met within the declared target.
status_semantics.LIMITED_GENERALIZABILITY: Some transport dimensions or outcomes limit the claim.
status_semantics.NOT_GENERALIZABLE: Registered transport criteria are not met.

guardrails: Generalization does not erase replication failures.
Different measurement instruments are not silently treated as identical.
No automatic universal claim is generated.
